adaptations: Only imported components (button, dialog, field, input, label, layer-card, loader, tooltip) and their transitive dependencies are included.
Lucide replaces Phosphor; clsx and tailwind-merge supply cn.
Motion animates Dialog; Base UI retains focus, modality and dismissal.
Upstream hook ordering and ref updates follow the project's React rules.
Unused LinkButton, Select, Collapsible, Tabs, SkeletonLine and FedRAMP theme are excluded.
Kumo semantic color tokens are bound to Simu-Emperor's warm cartographic palette in web/styles.css.
